title: Third download: two hours of experiencing multiple timelines

tellings.quote: And it came to me at a place where my whole world shattered for two hours where I was experiencing multiple timelines really

plain: A man named Brent describes what he calls his third download, a sudden flood of information that he says came to him after a formula he had been given resurfaced. He says that for two hours his whole world shattered and he was experiencing multiple timelines at once. He tells it as something that happened to him personally, though he gives no time or place.
